offlineAlert: The computer isn't listening right now. Messages you send wait until you type /phone on the computer.
pausedAlert: The line is paused. Claude gets no messages until you resume it here or type /phone on the computer.
deleteAsk: Permanently delete "%s" and all its messages?
md_Auto: Claude decides what is allowed. No permission requests.
md_Manual: Claude asks before every change. Requests come here.
md_Accept edits: File edits are allowed, other commands ask.
md_Plan: Claude only plans and shows a plan, no file changes.
md_Bypass permissions: All checks are off. Only the computer can change this.
pcSessions: Claude Code sessions on the computer
perm_timeout: Not answered in time. The request waits on the computer.
mCost: Switching models makes Claude re-read the whole conversation, which uses more of your limit.
mAsk: The app on the computer asks:
mNoAnswer: The computer didn't answer. Is the line on?
mOther: Another session is open on the computer. Open the phone's session there and try again.
mNoWin: The Claude app isn't open on the computer.
mFail: The switch didn't work on the computer.
mOtherNow: Note: another session is open on the computer right now.
noGptConv: ChatGPT is not connected yet. Type $phone in Codex on the computer.
offlineGpt: ChatGPT is not connected. Type $phone in Codex on the computer.
cxd_read-only: Codex reads files and runs commands but changes nothing.
cxd_workspace-write: Codex edits files in its work folder, no network.
cxNoCfg: The list arrives when the ChatGPT line is up on the computer.
emptyTitle: Hi, what are we doing today?
emptyTeam: A shared chat: I lead and hand work to ChatGPT when needed. You see who is working and what we tell each other (tap a message to open it), and anything addressed to you is in your language. To start, type /phone on the computer.
screenIntro: See your computer's screen on the phone and tap it, for example to approve a window that is waiting for you. You can stop at any time, a Stop button also shows on the computer screen, and sharing ends by itself after 10 minutes.
screenOffline: The computer is not connected. Type /phone on the computer.
membersHint: Untick a model to keep it out. One, two or all three can take part.
noGeminiConv: Gemini is not connected yet. Type /phone on the computer.
offlineGemini: Gemini is not connected. Type /phone on the computer.
emptyGemini: Type /phone on your computer and Gemini connects here, so you can chat with it from your phone.
emptyGpt: Type $phone in Codex on your computer and ChatGPT connects here, so you can chat with it from your phone.
emptyBody: Type /phone in the chat on your computer. Everything I write shows up here, and you can answer me and give me tasks from your phone.
pPaused: The line is paused. This message waits.
pOffline: The computer is offline. This message waits until you type /phone on the computer.
pWorking: Claude is mid-task and will read this between steps.
notifOnBtn: Notifications on · tap to turn off
notifDenied: Notifications are blocked in the browser settings
notifTest: Notifications are on. This is how you will be told when something finishes.
notifTestPush: Notifications are on, even when the screen is locked and the app is closed.
sendErr: The message wasn't sent. Check your connection and try again.
picErr: The photo wasn't sent. Try another or a smaller one.
loginLead: Sign in to your private chat with Claude.
signUpDone: We sent a confirmation email. Tap the link in it, then come back here and sign in with the password.
loginErr: Sign-in failed. Check the email and password; if this is your first time, confirm the email first.
oldConv: This is an earlier conversation. You can read it, not send to it.
quickHint: One button per line. Tapping a button sends its text right away.
micErr: The microphone isn't available. Allow it in the browser settings.
queuedNote: No network. The message sends by itself when you're back online.
fileErr: The file is too big (20MB max).
nudgeTxt: Turn on notifications to get a buzz when something finishes, even with the app closed.
pcNoAnswer: The computer didn't answer. Is the line on?
pcTokNote: Only Claude can read token usage; it updates while Claude works.
